items.q: And we do "St. Louis Blues" with Count Basie -- Joe Williams ending "Every Day, Every Day, Every Day."

ctx.x: And this is real traditional jazz. And we do "St. Louis Blues" with Count Basie -- Joe Williams ending "Every Day, Every Day, Every Day."
That really is one of your most walking performances on the stage.
